newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT surges 5.38 pct on first half net news.
newsitem.headline: PLDT surges 5.38 pct on first half net news.

text.p: The Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co climbed 50 pesos, or 5.38 percent, to 980 pesos in early trade on favourable first half earnings news, brokers said.

"They are on track. The news is positive and that's not even the end of it since they will benefit further if their new rate plan gets approved," said Sun Hung Kai Securities vice-president Raul Ruiz.
PLDT announced before trading started that its first half net income amounted to 3.752 billion pesos compared with 2.92 billion a year-ago.
PLDT emerged as the most actively traded issue eight minutes after the session started.
